Iran Warns of Wider Retaliation Amid Diplomatic Talks

Iran's supreme leader, Ali Khamenei, and the Iranian army have issued warnings against fresh attacks by the US and Israel. Khamenei threatened a wider military response to any threats, while the army cautioned that a new US attack would escalate the conflict. These warnings come even as diplomatic talks between Iran and the US are reportedly progressing.
